    S

    sectorsPerCluster - Variable in Klasse filesystem.BootSector
    Number of sectors in a cluster (1-128, must be power of 2)
    showAllDeletedFilesAndDirectories(Fat32Reader, Scanner) - Statische Methode in Klasse menu.DiskViewer
    Displays all deleted files and directories from all partitions.
    showAllFilesAndDirectories(Fat32Reader, Scanner) - Statische Methode in Klasse menu.DiskViewer
    Displays all files and directories from all partitions.
    showAllFilesAndDirectoriesFromDirectory(Fat32Reader, Scanner) - Statische Methode in Klasse menu.DiskViewer
    Searches for directories by name and displays their contents.
    showBootSectorInfos(Fat32Reader) - Statische Methode in Klasse menu.DiskViewer
    Displays boot sector information for all detected partitions.
    size - Variable in Klasse masterBootRecord.PartitionEntry
    Size of the partition in sectors (512 bytes each)
    startByte - Variable in Klasse filesystem.Partition
    Byte offset where the partition starts (512 × startLBA)
    startCHS - Variable in Klasse masterBootRecord.PartitionEntry
    Start CHS address (cylinder-head-sector format, 3 bytes)
    startCluster - Variable in Klasse filesystem.DirectoryEntry
    Starting cluster number of the file or directory (cluster 2 = first data cluster)
    startLBA - Variable in Klasse masterBootRecord.PartitionEntry
    Starting Logical Block Address (LBA) of the partition
